_comment: Golden snapshot of Logto's /.well-known/openid-configuration, captured from https://auth.babelstone.dev/oidc on 2026-07-08 (bd babelstone-zla1.10.5 slice 5). It locks the PKCE + grant contract behind IAM_OAUTH21_PKCE_ENFORCED (ADR-IC-021 C2). If Logto is ever reconfigured so its discovery drifts (e.g. advertises the weak 'plain' code_challenge method, or drops S256), update this snapshot in the SAME change so the drift is visible and acknowledged — the contract test test_iam_pkce_contract.py asserts against it.
